A docstring that names the path is reworded to the new address. hollow.py handed resolves_to an `exists` lambda, and a callable does not cross a bus, so resolves_to (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) gains `exists_in_repo=True`: the same predicate, existence asked of repo_root, named as a boolean. The outside sites call transitions.ask_inspector (public; _ask_inspector is D2's name for it); both_ends_agree asks run_sieve('question_links_agree', ...), already on the allow-list. Under a proof (CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID set) the ask rides inspect_wire's in-process scratch CodeMother, so the world a proof stands behind the inspector is the one its crossing reads, and a judge's own refusal (MalformedWorkflow and the gate reds) is raised again as its type. The two base probes read the sieve seed files by path and gate.py names the module only as a source label; neither imports it, and the path is 93fa3e3a6199's move to carry.
